policy: Connection endpoint/host name and hardware unique IDs are replaced; credentials are excluded. Numeric benchmark results, code revisions, software versions, CPU topology/affinity, request content and timings are retained.
not_included: model weights and downloaded dataset cache
container images and driver installer binaries
format_normalization: Text copies use UTF-8 without BOM and LF. JSON documents are pretty-printed with Unicode characters preserved. Numeric values and request data are unchanged. Invalid diagnostic JSON plus trailing driver stdout is published as .json.txt.
